name: 4-Core Armoured Cable 2.5mm²
description: Heavy-duty steel wire armoured (SWA) cable designed for underground and outdoor power distribution. Provides mechanical protection against impact and rodent damage. Ideal for industrial installations, street lighting, and main supply runs.

name: 4-Core Armoured Cable 10mm²
description: Robust SWA cable suitable for sub-main distribution in commercial and industrial buildings. Combines XLPE insulation with galvanised steel wire armour for long-term durability in harsh environments.

name: Single Core Armoured Cable 16mm²
description: Single core armoured cable for heavy current applications such as transformer connections, generator feeders, and main incoming supply lines.

name: Single Core PVC Cable 1.5mm²
description: Solid copper conductor with PVC insulation for general purpose wiring in conduit and trunking. Suitable for lighting circuits, control panels, and signalling.

name: Single Core PVC Cable 2.5mm²
description: Most commonly used PVC insulated cable for socket outlet rings and small power circuits in residential and commercial buildings.

name: Single Core PVC Cable 6mm²
description: Heavier gauge PVC cable for cooker circuits, water heaters, and sub-main feeds. Stranded copper conductor for ease of installation.

name: 3-Core Flexible Cable 1.5mm²
description: Highly flexible PVC insulated and sheathed cable for portable appliances, extension leads, and equipment with frequent movement.

name: 2-Core Flexible Cable 2.5mm²
description: Two-core flexible cable for power tools, pumps, and double-insulated appliances. Fine stranded copper for maximum flexibility.

name: 4-Core Flexible Cable 4mm²
description: Heavy duty 4-core flexible cable for three-phase portable equipment, welding sets, and temporary site power distribution.

name: PVC Conduit Pipe 20mm
description: Rigid PVC electrical conduit for surface and concealed wiring installations. Halogen-free, impact resistant, and easy to bend with heat.

name: PVC Conduit Pipe 25mm
description: Heavy gauge 25mm PVC conduit for larger cable runs in commercial and industrial installations. UV stabilised for outdoor use.

name: Flexible Conduit 25mm
description: Corrugated flexible conduit for protecting cables in tight bends and around machinery. Resistant to crushing and abrasion.

name: GI Pipe 20mm
description: Galvanised iron pipe for heavy-duty electrical installations requiring maximum mechanical protection. Threaded ends for screw connections.

name: PVC Pressure Pipe 32mm
description: High-pressure PVC pipe suitable for underground cable ducting and water service applications.

name: HDPE Cable Duct 50mm
description: High density polyethylene duct for underground cable protection. Flexible, corrosion-proof, and supplied in long continuous coils.

name: Copper Earth Rod 5/8" x 4ft
description: Solid copper-bonded steel earth rod for grounding electrical installations. Provides reliable low-resistance earth connection.

name: Bare Copper Earth Wire 16mm²
description: Bare stranded copper conductor for earthing and bonding applications. High conductivity for effective fault current dissipation.

name: Earth Clamp & Inspection Pit
description: Brass earth clamp with inspection housing for connecting earth conductor to earth rod. Includes weatherproof inspection chamber.
